entry_route.value: The PhD is a BS-entry program, so applicants apply straight from a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry (BS Entry)

also.quote: A satisfactory completion of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, official transcripts

gre_general.value: GRE scores are one route to unconditional admission; the other two routes use faculty letters instead.
gre_general.quote: A satisfactory completion of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, official transcripts, and GRE scores, and three letters of recommendation.

also.quote: plus a recommendation from a UT Arlington Chemistry and Biochemistry faculty member

english_waiver.value: Chemistry requires a TOEFL unless the undergraduate degree was in English, and then a waiver depends on recommendation letters.
english_waiver.quote: Those who have completed their undergraduate education in English may be eligible for a TOEFL waiver based on the recommendation letters.

also.quote: An applicant whose native language is not English must submit a TOEFL score of at least 550 or a score of at least 213 on the computer-based test

funding.value: Scholarships and fellowships go to students with no provisional conditions, on the same criteria as admission.
funding.quote: Students that have no provisional admission conditions to meet will be eligible for available scholarship and/or fellowship support.

also.quote: Award of scholarships or fellowships will be based on the same criteria utilized in admission decisions.

supervisor.value: Faculty recommendations matter, but the page sets no supervisor rule for admission.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is named for chemistry.

deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline.

notes: The language section gives only old-scale TOEFL minimums (paper 550, computer 213) and no iBT figure, so the university iBT 79 is not overridden. Scholarship eligibility also requires a 3.0 GPA in the last 60 undergraduate hours (catalog).
name: Chemistry PhD (BS Entry)
